purpose: Test whether the unchanged bounded source-routing mechanism observed on Batch C generalizes to Batch B health, history and design questions, and whether its exact-quote displacement risk also replicates.
interpretation: Batch B labels are model-generated and already available to the project. This is a post-hoc cross-domain Dev/Regression diagnostic, not blind product evidence and not a human Gold benchmark.
causalQuestion: With budgets and implementation unchanged from the Batch C run, does SR12_40 improve required-source coverage over L40_STRONG across three additional domains without losing exact required evidence?

arms.definition: Unchanged Batch C mechanism: rank sources by first occurrence in a bounded top-120 lexical pool, select at most 12, guarantee one Claim per selected source, then fill to at most 40 in lexical order.

decisionRules.BREADTH_SOURCE_PASS: At S50 SR12_40 aggregate required-source recall is >= L40_STRONG, has at least one strict per-question required-source win, zero per-question required-source losses, and all routing/candidate budgets pass.
decisionRules.BREADTH_FULL_PASS: BREADTH_SOURCE_PASS plus aggregate exact-quote recall >= L40_STRONG, zero per-question exact-quote losses, average evidence-closure tokens <=110% of L40, and at least one strict non-latency cost advantage: lower average evidence-closure tokens or fewer average lexical candidate records loaded.
decisionRules.QUOTE_RISK_REPLICATED: BREADTH_SOURCE_PASS passes but at least one per-question exact-quote loss occurs. Preserve the source-discovery signal, reject online integration, and require a relevance gate before guaranteed source slots.
decisionRules.NO_SOURCE_BENEFIT: There is no strict per-question required-source win over L40_STRONG.
decisionRules.REWORK: Any required-source loss, budget violation, scope/time leakage, stale-index acceptance, non-determinism, first-run overwrite, frozen-hash mismatch or Gold access before every candidate set is constructed.

stopRules: Do not change routingPoolBudget, sourceBudget, candidateBudget or source-ranking logic from the frozen Batch C mechanism.
Do not read or parse diagnostic Gold until both arms have been constructed for all 32 questions.
Do not generate answers, traverse Relation, build Context Pack, call a model, access the network or mutate canonical state.
Do not claim latency improvement from this run; alternating order only reduces warm-cache bias and latency remains descriptive.
Do not treat these model-generated labels as human Gold or blind product evidence.
Preserve the first report directory and hash; any fix must use a new run id.
